meta.note: tipo de alarma documentado en un objeto real de HUAWEI-XPON-MIB (render de Observium, nivel de evidencia B — ver docs/adaptacion_multivendor.md §2); no es un NOTIFICATION-TYPE/trap propio — Huawei no expone esos en ningún .mib fetched (ninguno de los 7 módulos ingeridos tiene kind=notification). oid_trap=null a propósito: no existe un OID de trap que citar, y no se fabrica uno.

MA5608T.name: optical_rxPower
MA5608T.description:
This object indicates the alarm type,
Options:
1. rxPower(1) - The alarm type is rxPower
2. txPower(2) - The alarm type is txPower
3. voltage(3) - The alarm type is voltage
4. temperature(4) - The alarm type is temperature
5. biasCurrent(5) - The alarm type is bias current
6. txPower10g(6) - The alarm type is 10G txPower
7. biasCurrent10g(7) - The alarm type is 10G bias current
8. catvRxPower(8) - The alarm type is catv rxPower

MA5608T.name: tdm_tf
MA5608T.description:
Transmit failure (TF). This object indicates the alarm type.
Options:
1. Transmit failure (TF),
2. Loss of frame (LOF),
3. Out of frame (OOF),
4. Remote alarm indication (RAI),
5. 2.048 Mbit/s alarm indication signal (AIS).
